name: Carbenoxolone
summary: Carbenoxolone (CBX) is a glycyrrhetinic acid derivative with a steroid-like structure, similar to substances found in the root of the licorice plant. Carbenoxolone is used for the treatment of peptic, esophageal and oral ulceration and inflammation. Electrolyte imbalance is a serious side effect of carbenoxolone when used systemically.

pharmacology.text: Carbenoxolone reversibly inhibits the conversion of inactive cortisone to cortisol by blocking 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (11β-HSD). Carbenoxolone is a modestly potent, reasonably effective, water-soluble blocker of gap junctions.

uses.text: Carbenoxolone is used for the treatment of peptic, esophageal and oral ulceration and inflammation. Electrolyte imbalance is a serious side effect of carbenoxolone when used systemically. Carbenoxolone has also been used in topical creams such as Carbosan gel, marketed for treatment of lip sores and mouth ulcers.

sideEffects.text: Electrolyte imbalance is a serious side effect of carbenoxolone when used systemically.

summaryZh: 甘珀酸（英語：Carbenoxolone，縮寫CBX）是一種甾體激素類似物，為甘草次酸與丁二酸在3β羥基位置形成的酯，和光果甘草根部中提取的甘草酸結構上類似。

fact.en: It is made from glycyrrhetinic acid, found in liquorice root. Eating a lot of real liquorice can raise blood pressure and lower potassium by blocking the same enzyme that carbenoxolone blocks.
fact.zh: 它是用甘草根中的甘草次酸製成的。大量吃含真正甘草的零食，會因為阻斷與甘珀酸相同的酵素，而使血壓升高、血鉀降低。
fact.zhHans: 它是用甘草根中的甘草次酸制成的。大量吃含真正甘草的零食，会因为阻断与甘珀酸相同的酵素，而使血压升高、血钾降低。
